instruction: A crisp action photograph with a full, eye-level shot captures an indoor boxing gym with concrete walls and yellow accents. On the left, the man in the orange beanie (R1), wearing a white t-shirt and blue sweatpants, stands holding a black heavy punching bag steady with both hands. On the right, the blonde woman in the purple hoodie (R2), wearing black leggings and brown boxing gloves, begins to retract her left arm after punching the bag, keeping her right glove near her face. The man watches the bag intently while the blonde woman maintains her boxing stance. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R1 holds the heavy punching bag steady with both hands while R2 punches it
R2 is the boxer retracting her left arm after punching the bag while R1 steadies the bag
